evidence.positive: GET /v3/api-docs on the running ff9e887 build (profiles local,docker; springdoc.api-docs.enabled=true) returned a 141315-byte spec with 164 paths and 191 schemas. No path contains 'launch-by-operation' (only /api/generate-app-launch-key, /api/cds/app-launch/{patientId}/{caseId}, /api/app-launch, /api/admin/reporting/generate-launch-report) and none of the schemas the ticket lists as leaked (ApplicationContext, AutowireCapableBeanFactory, BeanFactory, Environment, RedirectView, ServletContext, ServletRegistration, FilterRegistration, SessionCookieConfig, HttpStatus, HttpStatusCode, DefaultHttpStatusCode, JspConfigDescriptor, JspPropertyGroupDescriptor, TaglibDescriptor, LaunchByOperationId*) is present in components.schemas. The shipped /app/classes/com/guided/orci/web/AppLaunchController.class (md5 ee32678044effe5ce61766abf835f71b) carries io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Hidden in the RuntimeVisibleAnnotations of launchByOperationId(java.util.UUID) per javap.
evidence.negative: Hiding the method from the spec must not remove the endpoint or its siblings. Logged in as loopuser via form login, started a demo case (POST /api/app-launch, X-Tenant-Id demo-demo, patientId patient-1, caseId OR2842-CASE-1 -> 200) which created operation 01a178c1-61dd-74f4-b77f-d29b2195849e. GET /api/launch-by-operation/01a178c1-61dd-74f4-b77f-d29b2195849e with X-Tenant-Id demo-demo answered 302 with Location http://127.0.0.1:63916/app-launch?patient_id=patient-1&case_id=OR2842-CASE-1&client_id=demo-demo, no content-type and a 0-byte body (no container detail serialized). A bogus id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 answered 404 'Operation not found (...)', proving the handler is still mapped. The un-hidden sibling /api/app-launch on the same controller is still present in the spec.
evidence.red_check: Class swap with the pre-fix code. Compiled the parent commit's AppLaunchController.java (aa718da^1, no @Hidden import and no @Hidden on launchByOperationId; javap confirms only GetMapping in the method's RuntimeVisibleAnnotations) against the container's /app/classes + /app/libs with lombok as a local annotation processor, with one addition: a static initializer that logs the WARN marker 'OR-2842 RED CHECK ACTIVE: pre-fix AppLaunchController loaded, launchByOperationId has no @Hidden' so the swapped class leaves a distinctive log line. Backed up the shipped class, docker cp'd the pre-fix class into /app/classes (md5 a2618d2b4c2cd52f3fc66989f010cc81), restarted the container. The spec went red: 155768 bytes, 165 paths, 206 schemas, '/api/launch-by-operation/{operationId}' present with get -> 200 -> $ref #/components/schemas/RedirectView, and exactly the 15 leaked Spring/servlet schemas from the ticket present (ApplicationContext, AutowireCapableBeanFactory, BeanFactory, DefaultHttpStatusCode, Environment, FilterRegistration, HttpStatus, HttpStatusCode, JspConfigDescriptor, JspPropertyGroupDescriptor, RedirectView, ServletContext, ServletRegistration, SessionCookieConfig, TaglibDescriptor); the marker appeared once in docker logs. Reverted: restored the backup, md5 matches the shipped ee32678044effe5ce61766abf835f71b, restarted, spec back to 141315 bytes / 164 paths / 191 schemas with no launch-by-operation path and no leaked schemas, and the redirect for the real operation again answered 302 to /app-launch?patient_id=patient-1&case_id=OR2842-CASE-1&client_id=demo-demo.

red_check_signature: OR-2842 RED CHECK ACTIVE: pre-fix AppLaunchController loaded, launchByOperationId has no @Hidden
caveats: The red-check log signature is a WARN marker added to the pre-fix class's static initializer by this run; springdoc itself logs nothing when it introspects RedirectView, so there was no naturally occurring line to key on. The red observation itself is the regressed spec content.

springdoc.api-docs is disabled in the aws-dev and aws-prod profiles, so the live spec surface validated here only exists under the local profile; in deployed environments the ticket's effect is confined to the generated TypeScript client.
The regenerated TypeScript client was checked only via the merged diff (pure 592-line removal); npm run typecheck and npm run generate:api were not re-run in this session.
The only consumer, the Debug tab's copy-launch-link button, was not clicked through the UI; its target endpoint was exercised directly and still redirects.

automation.assessment: No existing test touches /v3/api-docs or launch-by-operation in qa-suite or orci/src/test. Worth locking in as a backend test rather than a qa-suite e2e, because api-docs is disabled on dev so a post-deploy Playwright check would never see the spec. A Spring Boot MockMvc test over /v3/api-docs asserting the launch-by-operation path is absent and no schema named RedirectView/ApplicationContext/ServletContext exists guards this method; a stricter generic version (no response schema $ref may resolve to a Spring View/container type) would catch the next controller that returns a View, which the ticket note calls out as the real risk.
proposed_tests: Backend (orci/src/test, @SpringBootTest + MockMvc): GET /v3/api-docs -> paths has no key containing 'launch-by-operation' and components.schemas has none of RedirectView, ApplicationContext, ServletContext, Environment, BeanFactory
Backend (same test class): GET /api/launch-by-operation/{unknown uuid} -> 404 Operation not found, proving @Hidden did not unmap the handler

Backend generic guard: for every operation in /v3/api-docs, no 200 response schema $ref resolves to a class assignable to org.springframework.web.servlet.View or ApplicationContext (red check: temporarily drop @Hidden and watch it fail)

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: The live OpenAPI spec on the ff9e887 build has no launch-by-operation path and none of the 15 leaked Spring container schemas.
Negative: GET /api/launch-by-operation/{id} for a real demo operation still answers 302 to /app-launch with an empty body, an unknown id still 404s, and the sibling /api/app-launch path remains in the spec.
Red check: Swapping in the pre-fix controller class without @Hidden put the path back in the spec as a 200 returning RedirectView along with all 15 container schemas, and restoring the shipped class removed them again.

Automation: A backend MockMvc test over /v3/api-docs is proposed, since api-docs is disabled on dev and a qa-suite check would never see the spec.
